name: Skeptical claim audit
audience: Critical readers, reviewers and engineering teams deciding which ideas to operationalize
sourcePolicy: Shared corpus only; adversarial reading from scratch; no external validation and no other experiment output
workflow: Extract material claims rather than topics
goodEnoughDefinition: The audit makes the argument safer to reuse by separating robust mechanisms from analogy, inference and provocation, without demanding certainty the talk never claims.
reviewChecks: Every claim has assumption and challenge
Incident examples are not generalized silently
CSV and HTML carry the same rows
